outlets.name: App\Support\ChangeLog\ChangeLogDescriptions
outlets.description: Change log: per stored event type a part and a readable sentence with its Undo or the reason there is none, from classes implementing App\Contracts\ChangeLog\DescribesChanges tagged changelog.descriptions; unregistered types read "Wijziging vastgelegd" under "Overig". See docs/change-log.md.

outlets.name: App\Contracts\ChangeLog\DescribesChanges
outlets.description: Change log: a class that adds parts, sentences and table words to ChangeLogDescriptions; tag it changelog.descriptions in a service provider.

outlets.name: App\Contracts\ChangeLog\ChangeLogAgents
outlets.description: Change log: the name, agent key and on-behalf-of user of agent and bridge actors, and the agents the "Wie" filter offers.

outlets.name: App\Contracts\ChangeLog\ChangeLogAccess
outlets.description: Change log: the trust level of a user per part; null hides the part's rows, Act also allows undo when the counter-Action names no ability.

outlets.name: App\Contracts\ChangeLog\ChangeLogArchive
outlets.description: Change log: read-only history from before the move to events, shown under "Vóór de overstap" and appended to the CSV export.
